_readme: Strings whose upstream Arabic is a FALSE FRIEND on the desk: another app translates
the same English word in a different sense, so inheriting its row would be wrong
on our surface. Two consumers read this file: tools/i18n_inherited.mjs refuses to
inherit these (we ship our own row), and bunood_theme.setup._defend_false_friends
asserts the `defend: true` ones site-wide on every migrate through a Translation
row - because the runtime dictionary is one flat merge in install order and this
app sits third of ten, so a later app's row overwrites ours before the desk sees
it (measured 2026-09-14: 17 of 29 lost). `defend: false` marks an entry whose
upstream sense is RIGHT on the other app's own screens (erpnext's Ledger is the
accounting ledger); those must carry a translation context at our call sites
instead, and are listed here so the generator still refuses the inheritance.
Small and argued; not a place to park anything awkward.

Count.reason: upstream عد is the VERB 'to count'; ours is a badge count (noun)

More.reason: upstream أكثر is the comparative 'more than'; a More button is المزيد

Full.reason: upstream ممتلئ means 'filled up'; ours is full intensity

Center.reason: upstream مركز is a hub (cost centre), not centre alignment

Mention.reason: upstream أشير is a verb; ours is a noun — but it is Frappe's own notification type, so we ship no row either

Mentions.reason: upstream يذكر is a verb; ours is a noun

Action.reason: helpdesk حدث is an EVENT/occurrence; ours is a thing the user does — إجراء

Apply.reason: crm تقديم is submitting an application; ours applies a setting — تطبيق

Filter.reason: frappe منقي is a purifier; a filter control is تصفية

Display.reason: frappe عرض is generic view; ours names the item-25 metric STYLE (عرض بارز) and must not flatten to it

Translations.reason: frappe ترجمة is singular; our nav section is plural — الترجمات

Queued.reason: frappe قائمة الانتظار is the queue (a noun); ours is a STATUS — في قائمة الانتظار

Automatic.reason: frappe معادلة is a formula; ours is the colour mode that follows the OS — تلقائي

Both.reason: erpnext على حد سواء is 'alike'; ours is both halves of a title / both gridlines — كلاهما

Clear.reason: frappe واضح is 'obvious'; ours is the action that clears a field — مسح

Light.reason: frappe ضوء is a lamp's light (noun); the colour mode is فاتح

Dark.reason: frappe مظلم is 'gloomy'; kept with Light so the colour-mode pair agrees — داكن

Link.reason: frappe حلقة الوصل is a liaison; a hyperlink is رابط

List View.reason: frappe عرض منسدل is a DROPDOWN view; the list view is عرض القائمة

Original.reason: frappe إبداعي is 'creative'; our stand-down pole is the stock look — الأصلي

Records.reason: erpnext تسجيل is 'recording' (singular verbal noun); ours is the plural noun — سجلات

Saved Filters.reason: frappe حفظ الفلاتر is the imperative 'save the filters'; ours is a heading — المحفوظة

Show.reason: frappe تبين is 'it turns out'; the pair with Hide (إخفاء) is إظهار

Solid.reason: frappe صلب is 'rigid'; the pane material is opaque — معتم

Split.reason: erpnext انشق، مزق is 'tore apart'; the two-pane login layout is مُقسَّم

Subtle.reason: frappe دقيق is 'precise'; a subtle wash is faint — خفيفة

Theme.reason: frappe موضوع is a topic; a visual theme is السمة (the ar.po note already says so)

Letter.reason: frappe رسالة is a message; the email style shaped like a formal letter is خطاب

Ledger.reason: erpnext دفتر الأستاذ is the general-ledger account book; the Ledger look is a ruled page — دفتر
